learning_outcomes.text: Distinguish corporate-level strategy from business-unit strategy
Analyse industry structure and sources of competitive advantage
Choose where to compete across businesses, markets and the value chain
Evaluate diversification, vertical integration and corporate parenting logic
Build defensible advantage through positioning and distinctive capabilities
Test whether a corporate strategy actually creates value above the sum of parts

integrative_case: A diversified industrial group under activist pressure must justify why it owns eight unrelated businesses: analyse each industry's structure, apply the better-off and ownership tests, decide which units to keep, fix or sell, and build the corporate-strategy case for the retained portfolio.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
